title: ID0444557-DC/Si-D/IE- [MP/S2 170003304] QA1 failing to close
description:
Reported issue/Behaviour: QA1 failing to close, fault found during commissioning
Solution: Replace MA1
Note from site: QA1 was not able to close totally:
As you can see, the closing, was only half way, which indicates that the MA1 couldn't close it properly.
After MA1 replacement, it's working again
